title: A/E for Monie Bay Field Station
short_description: Design services for a new research facility at Deal Island Wildlife Management Area.
project_location: Deal Island Wildlife Management Area, Princess Anne, Somerset County, Maryland, USA
project_scope: Professional design services for a new research facility at Deal Island Wildlife Management Area. The notice identifies a general building project but provides no gross floor area, structural system, span, height, or other technical building characteristics.
services: Architecture, interior design/space planning, landscape architecture, programming, civil engineering, surveying/GIS/mapping, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, and structural engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Building project with structural engineering included, so there is a potential entry point for sbp.
- However, the notice describes a general research facility without any indication of large spans, special structures, innovative materials, or architecturally demanding features.
- Scope appears broad and led by full A/E services rather than a structure-focused assignment.
- Wildlife management area context does not by itself indicate a complex or iconic building.
- Limited technical information reduces strategic attractiveness.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the notice. Available information only indicates a new research facility under a general building procurement with multidisciplinary design services; no area, program size, or technical parameters are provided, so a realistic cost estimate is not possible from the source alone.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated in the notice. Because neither construction cost nor scope by service phase is quantified, a realistic sbp fee estimate is not possible from the source alone.
references_qualifications: Professional A/E team requested with disciplines including architecture, interior design/space planning, landscape architecture, programming, civil engineering, surveying/GIS/mapping, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, and structural engineering. The notice also states a 20% MBE contract participation goal.
